query: 鲍师傅糕点 北京路 越秀区 广州

tips.en: Pastry chain known for pork-floss cakes. No branch near Beijing Road was found on Google Maps (the nearest is ~1.5 km away on Zhongshan 3rd Road); the nearest should be searched in Amap (高德).
tips.zh: 以肉松小贝出名的糕点连锁。Google地图上北京路附近没有分店（最近的在中山三路，约1.5公里），用高德搜最近的。

query: 大鸽饭 西湖路68号 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Squab restaurant on Xihu Road, ~5 min from Beijing Road.
summary.zh: 西湖路的乳鸽餐厅，离北京路步行街约5分钟。

why.en: A squab specialist a short walk from Beijing Road; the Beijing Road food guide names braised and salt-baked squab as the dishes to order.
why.zh: 专做乳鸽，离北京路很近；北京路美食攻略推荐红烧乳鸽和盐焗乳鸽。

tips.en: Address: 68 Xihu Road (西湖路68号), Yuexiu. Google Maps lists ¥100–150 per person; opening hours were not shown. Another branch is at the zoo's south gate.
tips.zh: 地址：越秀区西湖路68号。Google地图显示人均约¥100至150，营业时间未显示；动物园南门另有分店。

query: 啫神 北京路 越秀区 广州

tips.en: Named in a Beijing Road food guide, but no Guangzhou branch near Beijing Road was found on Google Maps. To be checked in Amap (高德) before going.
tips.zh: 出自北京路美食攻略，但Google地图上没找到北京路附近的分店，去之前用高德确认。

query: 禄鼎记 北京路 越秀区 广州

tips.en: Named in a Beijing Road food guide, but Google Maps shows branches only ~1.7 km away or farther (Jianshe 6th Road, Tianhe). To be checked in Amap (高德) before going.

query: 大头虾越式风味 惠福东路548号 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Vietnamese restaurant on Huifu East Road, near Beijing Road.
summary.zh: 惠福东路的越南菜餐厅，靠近北京路。

why.en: A change from Cantonese food, ~5 min from Beijing Road; the food guide names the tom yum and Vietnamese roll platter.
why.zh: 想换口味吃越南菜，离北京路约5分钟；攻略推荐冬阴功和越式手卷拼盘。

en: Vietnamese roll platter (越式手卷拼盘)

tips.en: Address: 548 Huifu East Road (惠福东路548号), Yuexiu. Another branch is in Guangming Plaza, 63 Xihu Road.
tips.zh: 地址：越秀区惠福东路548号。西湖路63号光明广场另有一家分店。

query: 五代同糖 北京路147号 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Dessert shop at the south end of Beijing Road.
summary.zh: 北京路步行街南段的甜品店。

why.en: On Beijing Road itself, so dessert needs no extra walk; the food guide names its mango pomelo sago shaved ice and milk mochi.
why.zh: 就在北京路上，不用多走；攻略推荐杨枝甘露雪花冰和牛奶麻薯。

en: Mango pomelo sago shaved ice (杨枝甘露雪花冰)

tips.en: Address: 147 Beijing Road (北京路147号). The Google Maps listing has no photo or reviews yet; hours unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 地址：北京路147号。Google地图上还没有照片和评价，营业时间未核实。

query: 明记甜品 文明路205号 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Dessert shop on Wenming Road, the dessert street.
summary.zh: 文明路甜品街上的甜品店。

why.en: On the same street as Baihua Dessert, so it is an easy swap; the food guide names peach-gum papaya milk and mango double-skin milk.
why.zh: 和百花甜品同一条街，随时可以换；攻略推荐桃胶木瓜奶和芒果双皮奶。

tips.en: Address: 205 Wenming Road (文明路205号). Google Maps rating is from only 8 reviews; hours were not shown.
tips.zh: 地址：文明路205号。Google地图只有8条评价，营业时间未显示。

query: 红遍天 十三行路13号-1 广州

summary.en: Clothing centre on Shisanhang Road, in the Thirteen Hongs wholesale district.
summary.zh: 十三行路上的服装城，在十三行批发区内。

why.en: Listed in a Guangzhou shopping infographic for 18–25: young, Korean-style, trend-led pieces at friendly prices. It is in the same street as the Thirteen Hongs buildings, so both are covered in one trip.
why.zh: 一张广州买衣服攻略图把它列在18–25岁：年轻、韩系、网红款，价格亲民。和十三行在同一条路，可以一起逛。

tips.en: Google Maps shows 10:00 opening; hours were seen once and should be checked on Amap (高德). Some stalls may be wholesale-only.
tips.zh: Google 地图显示10:00开门，只看到一次，出发前在高德确认。部分档口可能只批发。

query: U:US 广园西路14号 广州

summary.en: Clothing mall on Guangyuan West Road, about 500 m from Baima Clothing Market.
summary.zh: 广园西路上的服装商场，离白马服装市场约500米。

why.en: Listed in a Guangzhou shopping infographic for 25–30 (workwear, polished, understated designs) and for designer-style pieces. Close to Baima, so it fits the Jan 3 morning.
why.zh: 一张广州买衣服攻略图把它列在25–30岁（通勤、时尚、简约设计款），也列在“精品/设计感”。离白马很近，可以放在1月3日上午一起逛。

tips.en: About 500 m (straight line) from Baima. Hours not confirmed; check on Amap (高德).
tips.zh: 离白马直线约500米。营业时间未核实，出发前在高德确认。
